claims: Rory McIlroy became the fourth golfer in history to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.
Rory McIlroy won the 2025 Masters in a playoff victory over Justin Rose.
Rory McIlroy won the 2026 Masters tournament.
Rory McIlroy shot a 1-under 71 in the final round of the 2026 Masters.
Rory McIlroy finished the 2026 Masters at 12-under-par.
Rory McIlroy won the 2026 Masters one shot ahead of Scottie Scheffler.
Jack Nicklaus won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 1965 and 1966.
Jack Nicklaus was the first to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.
Jack Nicklaus won the 1965 Masters by nine strokes.
Jack Nicklaus won the 1966 Masters by defeating Tommy Jacobs and Gay Brewer in a playoff.
Nick Faldo won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 1989 and 1990.
Nick Faldo won the 1989 Masters in a playoff against Scott Hoch.
The 1989 Masters was the first of Nick Faldo's three Masters titles.
Nick Faldo won the 1990 Masters in a playoff over Ray Floyd.
Tiger Woods won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 2001 and 2002.
Tiger Woods was the last player to win back-to-back Masters before 2026.
Tiger Woods won the 2001 Masters by two strokes over Retief Goosen.
Tiger Woods won the 2002 Masters by three strokes over Phil Mickelson.
